source: The identity path means the old representation remains directly available while the sublayer contributes a learned modification. This idea predates Transformers: residual networks were introduced to make very deep networks easier to optimize by learning residual functions relative to their inputs. [2]
zh: 身份路径意味着旧的表示仍然直接可用，而子层提供学习的修改。这个想法早于变形金刚：引入残差网络是为了通过学习相对于输入的残差函数，使非常深的网络更容易优化。 [2]
